_comment: Frameworks in scope for a complete cross-framework run. Version policy: latest-vs-latest (SGLang origin/main HEAD vs each competitor's newest line). A complete run includes every framework here for every case; a cell a framework cannot run must be classified in the case file (unsupported / no_profile / failed / not_run / invalid) — never silently dropped.

sglang.role: reference (SGLang-Diffusion — the system this benchmark guards)

vllm-omni.attention: env DIFFUSION_ATTENTION_BACKEND (exact: FLASH_ATTN on Hopper, FLASHINFER_ATTN on Blackwell)
vllm-omni.scope: image + video where a serving path exists

lightx2v.attention: attn_type in lightx2v_config; exact default flash_attn3. NEVER sage_attn2/svg (lossy) in the main comparison.
lightx2v.parallel: lightx2v_config.parallel: tensor_p_size (shard weights) | seq_p_size (shard activations, ulysses all-to-all, lossless) | cfg_p_size
lightx2v.scope: image + video where a serving path exists

trtllm-visual.launch: trtllm-serve (--backend pytorch; --tp_size N appended when num_gpus=N)
trtllm-visual.engines: TensorRT engines same-dtype, no quantization, no TeaCache, no torch compile (cache-free, comparable)
trtllm-visual.scope: required for image cases; video (Wan / LTX-2 / Cosmos3) supported per coverage — classify per case, do not drop

comfyui.role: competitor (ComfyUI -- the node-graph runtime most consumer-GPU users run these models in)
comfyui.version_policy: ComfyUI master HEAD + newest stable torch from PyTorch's CUDA index
comfyui.launch: python main.py (workflow-graph API: POST /prompt, websocket completion)
comfyui.weights: full-precision single-file checkpoints (Comfy-Org repackaging or the model's own single-file release). The official templates default to fp8/int8/nvfp4 variants, a different numeric class -- never use those in the main comparison.
comfyui.parallel: single GPU; the one multi-GPU path is the core MultiGPU CFG Split node, which runs CFG branches on separate cards
comfyui.workflows: configs/benchmark/comfyui/<name>.json, API format; build_benchmark_config.py inlines them
comfyui.scope: every case ComfyUI's core nodes support; classify the rest

fastvideo.role: competitor (FastVideo, Hao AI Lab -- the home engine of the FastH3 distillations)
fastvideo.version_policy: FastVideo main HEAD; fastvideo-kernel built from the same checkout (its `fasth3` extra)
fastvideo.launch: fastvideo serve --config <stub> --generator.* / --server.* overrides (every setting on the command line); video is POST /v1/videos/sync, which answers with the MP4
fastvideo.attention: dense: FLASH_ATTN -> FA3 on Hopper, FA4 on Blackwell (FASTVIDEO_FA4=1); FastH3: the checkpoint's trained VIDEO_SPARSE_ATTN_H3 (ThunderKittens sm_90a / sm_100a kernel)
fastvideo.lossless: on: resident components, regional DiT compile where FastVideo has a compile-safe route, bit-identical FASTVIDEO_MINIMAX_H3_EXACT_KERNELS / FASTVIDEO_H3_VSA_HEADS_FIRST_TILE / FASTVIDEO_H3_VAE_TILE_PARALLEL (#1930) and FASTVIDEO_ULYSSES_A2A=auto (#1807). off (they change the output): FASTVIDEO_MINIMAX_H3_FUSIONS, FASTVIDEO_MINIMAX_H3_FA4_PACKED_VARLEN, NVFP4/FP8, the TAEH3 decoder; also the reference memo (a cache)
fastvideo.scope: MiniMax-H3 cases (T2V+A, Ref2V+A, FastH3 8-Step V2); classify the rest
